title: Ramsey-Inspired Environmental Connectivity as a Driver of Early Universe Star Formation Efficiency: An AI-Led Theoretical Investigation

contributions.purpose: 用数学必然性解释 JWST 观测到的 z>10 高恒星形成效率
contributions.mechanism: 将 Ramsey 理论(大随机系统必含高度组织子结构)类比到宇宙网,提出多向连通节点提升气体供给/引力聚焦/反馈抗性,并定义方向多样性度量(k_dir、H_dir、S_dir、R_conc)
contributions.evaluation: 纯理论类比,无严格定理;宣称可解释 εgal 0.3-0.5(常规峰值约 0.2)的异常
contributions.domain: 理论宇宙学 / 星系形成
contributions.source_quote: Multi-directional connectivity in the primordial cosmic web creates mathematically guaranteed environments that transiently elevate galaxy formation efficiency beyond predictions based solely on halo mass and local density.

contributions.purpose: 在受控环境中隔离连通性效应并验证框架
contributions.mechanism: AI 设计"解耦"合成实验:120 中心节点+2000 背景晕的玩具宇宙网,人为固定邻居数分布以打破密度-连通性相关,效率真值按 β∈[0,0.2] dex/filament 注入
contributions.evaluation: 方向多样性与残差效率相关 ρ≈0.47(k_dir 0.471/H_dir 0.457/S_dir 0.476),密度去耦成功(ρ=0.031,p=0.735),偏相关 0.522,效应 ~0.4 dex≈2.5 倍
contributions.source_quote: Through autonomous experimental design, a synthetic validation framework demonstrates that directional diversity metrics correlate robustly with elevated efficiency ( 0.47, p < 107) independent of local density, with effect sizes of ~0.4 dex corresponding to factor ~2.5 enhancements.

contributions.purpose: 给出可证伪的观测预言
contributions.mechanism: 预言最高效 z>10 星系应优先占据多丝节点(控制晕质量与局部密度后仍成立)、有特征聚类与形态偏好、早期快速组装后回归标准演化轨迹;提出用 Roman/Euclid+JWST 后续检验
contributions.evaluation: 纯展望,未与任何真实数据或模拟对比
contributions.source_quote: Environmental Signatures: The highest-efficiency z > 10 galaxies should preferentially occupy multi-filament nodes in cosmic web reconstructions, even after controlling for halo mass and local density.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Ramsey Theory establishes that for any sufficiently large complete graph, certain monochromatic subgraphs must exist (Graham et al. 1990). Applied to cosmology: regions of the early universe containing N 1011 matter tracers must exhibit guaranteed clustering patterns within Hubble times.

notes: reject;核心方法学疑点:"验证"是在自造合成数据中回收人为注入的效率信号(ground truth 由 β 参数注入),属循环验证,未接触真实模拟或 JWST 数据;Ramsey 定理到宇宙网的映射仅为松散类比,无定理级对应(checklist 理论证明项自答 NA)。排版严重损坏:公式碎裂(")+N(0,)")、统计量乱码("p3.2108"疑为 p≈3.2e-108、摘要"p < 107"疑为 p<1e-7)、关键词行重复、章节编号 0.x/数字混排——疑 AI 生成 LaTeX 未经人工校对。AI 披露:假设发展 [B](人类提出 Ramsey→宇宙网核心联想),实验设计/分析/写作均 [D](AI>95%);Observed AI Limitations 自承 LaTeX 模板合规、方程重建、匿名维护均需人工返工。附 Human Collaborator Statement、Responsible AI Statement,checklist 完整填写。
